summary: Glucotrack filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 169,388 common shares at $2.04 per share plus 1,350,220 pre-funded warrants priced at $2.039 with a $0.001 exercise price, exercisable immediately with a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker (up to 9.99% at holder election). Dawson James acts as placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis with no minimum or escrow. Net proceeds fund general corporate purposes and working capital. Nasdaq-listed GCTK closed at $2.03 on September 23, 2026. Watch dilution, warrant overhang, and PIPE pricing relative to market.
